basic_info.description: Top floor newly remodeled flat in the best Noe Valley location! Fabulous home with three bedrooms and two bathrooms, one ensuite. All new stainless steel appliances in a large eat-in kitchen with plentiful cabinetry, undercabinet lighting and lovely quartz countertops. Designer features throughout including Hansgrohe fixtures, Toto toilets, Robern medicine cabinets, white oak floors, recessed lighting, CAT-6 wiring, and Air Conditioning! As a detached building with large bay windows, sunlight is plentiful. Side-by-side LG washer and dryer are in a laundry room off the kitchen, which leads to a south-facing deck and exclusive use area in the beautifully landscaped rear yard. A Walk Score of 96 allows for a gentle stroll on the Sanchez Slow Street to all the amazing amenities on 24th St. A very similar first floor flat is also available with comparable features.
